title: Custom Hooks
description: Learn how to create reusable logic with custom hooks.

data.text: **Custom hooks** let you extract component logic into reusable functions. They start with 'use' and can call other hooks.

data.title: useCounter Hook
useFetch Hook
useLocalStorage
Hook Rules
data.text: Custom hooks must follow the rules of hooks: only call hooks at the top level (not in loops or conditions) and only call them from React functions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Hooks make logic shareable across components
data.takeaway: Custom hooks are powerful for code reuse. Let's learn about context and refs.
